# DST Eco

> eco.dst.llc is DST's eco portfolio: a running record of individual, self-funded environmental initiatives, each documented on its own page as it actually happens. It is not a corporate sustainability programme and has no fixed set of initiatives — entries get added as facts come in.

## Important framing

- Nothing described here is a carbon offset. No credits are sold, no neutrality claim is made, and none of this activity is counted against DST's own footprint.
- Each portfolio entry has its own page under /portfolio/. Photo and location are optional fields, filled in only when actually available — never estimated.
- The current entry is a planting of Douglas fir saplings in Sverdlovsk region, Russia, funded by DST's founder via a friend (Max F.) who sourced and planted them.

## News & events

- [News](https://eco.dst.llc/news/): Updates about the portfolio itself — new records, how it's run — kept separate from the individual planting records under /portfolio/. Short, first-party items only; an empty feed means nothing to report yet, not a missing page.
- [Events](https://eco.dst.llc/events/): Planting days and other in-person activity, published once something is scheduled.

Sources, where cited, are named in the article text ("Source: X"), never linked as a live URL.

## Links

- [Instagram @eco.dst.llc](https://www.instagram.com/eco.dst.llc/): dated posts and photographs — the primary record of this work.
- [dst.llc](https://dst.llc): the group's commercial work. Deliberately not cross-sold from the eco site.
